method: Unweighted arithmetic mean of one regular-price bone-in order per restaurant, using an order closest to 10 pieces (ties prefer the smaller order), with standard Buffalo or base seasoning where available. Exclude meal bundles, specials, weight-only listings and unconfirmed whole-wing units. Included dips and garnish vary. Brand-level and representative-branch menus are identified; this is not a population-representative national price.
